criteria.formal_integrity: datum, extrema, trend, disclosure, and no-live-reading constraints survive
criteria.machine_native_pressure: medium; source pressure is real, but the surface still stages the source table too directly
criteria.reader_action: medium-low; the reader is asked good questions, but the poem often supplies its thesis as instruction
criteria.surface_language: cleaner than D001 and less foggy than P0001, but still heavily label-driven
criteria.disclosure_survival: honest draft-stage non-claim; no promotion supported

diagnosis: D002 made genuine progress: it turned datum choice into the central question and avoided P0001 codework fog.
Its strongest line is "When I say water, ask: against which zero?" because it changes an ordinary word by forcing a reference frame.
Its weakness is structural: much of the surface remains a verified datum list followed by explanatory questions.
The poem needs a physical object or location from the station record so the numbers push against a place rather than float as civic metadata.
A live water-level reading was not captured, so the next revision must not smuggle in currentness.
revision_demand: Draft P0002-D003 only if it uses a concrete station/bench-mark object as pressure and adds durable source-excerpt capture for the volatile facts it depends on.
non_claim: This cold review does not admit D002, does not make it an evidence candidate, and does not claim external reader validation.
